Hi all — quick investigation notes and attached log excerpt.

What we found (summary):
- Time window: 2027-05-21T22:03:00Z -> 2027-05-22T21:57:00Z.
- Root cause: brief regression in our edge retry code that incorrectly retried POST bodies for sessions that were already acknowledged by the serving cluster. This produced duplicate downstream generate calls for ~1.5% of long-running sessions, but those sessions had large context windows so they account for ~9x the usual token delta.
- Impact: pilot estimate is +970k billed tokens for Valence during the window. We correlated 83 session IDs in your CSV to repeated request IDs in our logs.

Actions taken so far:
1) Rolled back the retry change at 2027-05-22T02:10:00Z and blocked the problematic edge path.
2) Extracted a redwood-log-excerpt-session-replay.txt with matching request IDs and timestamps (attached).
3) Opened an internal billing adjustment request — pending finance approval.

Attachments: redwood-log-excerpt-session-replay.txt (text/plain, 32KB) — contains our server-side request IDs mapped to your session IDs.

Next steps:
- Sofia / Neha: will propose a compensation amount and timeline for credit posting.
- Jin: if you can confirm the 83 session IDs look right vs your CSV, we'llaccelerate the reconciliation.

—Marissa

- Cause: edge retry regression causing session-level resubmissions (not a user-initiated resend).
- Correlation: 83 Valence session IDs match repeated server request IDs in our logs. Excerpt attached.

- Preventive steps: we have blocked the edge path, added a server-side dedupe check for session request IDs, and updated our integration notes to help customers detect replay storms.

Attachments included: redwood-log-excerpt-session-replay.txt; credit-approval-statement.pdf (signed by Ops Lead).

Action items for Valence:

- If you want the credit split across invoices instead of lump sum, tell us and we can accommodate.

DocuSign link (provisional): https://docusign.example.com/valence-credit-approval
